# Landlord Safety First

> Landlord safety certificates in East London, by a qualified electrician who is also Gas Safe registered, based in Whitechapel (London E1) and covering anywhere within 25 miles. Services: EICRs, gas safety certificates (CP12), boiler servicing, fire alarm and emergency lighting tests, fire risk assessments, EPCs, PAT testing, EICR remedial works, consumer unit replacement and fault finding. Customers: private landlords, homeowners and small businesses. Does not do full rewires.

## Key facts
- Phone: see website
- Email: info@landlordsafetyfirst.uk
- Base: Whitechapel, London E1; service radius 25 miles
- Gas Safe Register number: pending
- Electrical scheme: pending
- Sister company for emergency electrical repairs: Emergency Services 24/7 (https://emergencyservice247.co.uk)

## Prices (from, including VAT)
- EICR, flat: £180 inc. VAT
- EICR, house: £240 inc. VAT
- Gas safety certificate (CP12): £144 inc. VAT
- EICR + gas safety for a 2-bed flat, one visit: £294
- Fire alarm test: £180 inc. VAT
- Emergency lighting test: £144 inc. VAT
- Electrical work / remedial works: £144 inc. VAT per hour, one-hour minimum
- Minimum visit: £144 inc. VAT. Booking 2 certificates together saves 10%, 3 or more saves 15%.
